Place the pinned clap repo from free-audio here.

https://github.com/free-audio/clap

This folder (CLAP_SDK) should be the root of the repo at
195b42a004144fab0b3cf95e9c067187d15365b7 (CLAP 1.2.10).

For a non-destructive fetch into a separate empty directory, run
IPLUG_CLAP_DEPS_DIR=/path/to/deps ./download-clap-layout-sdks.sh from this directory.
